name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
description: A Central Sector pension scheme for small and marginal farmers (SMFs) providing an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 on reaching 60 years of age.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land
benefits: Assured minimum monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 to eligible small and marginal farmers upon reaching 60 years of age, with 50% family pension payable to spouse upon subscriber death.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Central sector old age pension scheme applicable to small and marginal farmers across all States and UTs.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Small and marginal farmers who possess cultivable land up to 2 hectares in the land records of the concerned State/UT, aged between 18 and 40 years.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 on attaining age 60, with equal matching contribution by Central Government during accumulation phase.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Official scheme portal and registration access hosted at pmkmy.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Active nationwide rollout executed through LIC as pension fund manager and CSC network for citizen enrollment.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Farmers covered under other social security schemes (NPS, ESIC, EPFO) or institutional landholders are excluded.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card for beneficiary identification and e-KYC.
required_documents.guidance: Aadhaar number linked to active mobile phone number.

required_documents.title: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni/Khasra/Patta)
required_documents.description: Certified land record showing cultivable land up to 2 hectares in applicant's name.
required_documents.guidance: Verify land extract via state Bhulekh portal or Tehsildar.

required_documents.title: Savings Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Bank passbook or cancelled cheque with IFSC and account number.
required_documents.guidance: Account must have auto-debit facility enabled for monthly contribution.
